answer: Each agent claims one delta distributary mouth, locks 70 credits, and at nadir tide sends a key-signed echo ping to a bank reflector, logging its return delay. An auditor recomputes expected delay from the distance table; delay over 5% off, a missing log, or a reused ping burns the bond. First ping 32 credits; kth 32+7(k-1); 1000th 7025; 1000 fakes pay 3,528,500 plus 70,000 locked, each ping tied to one delta mouth and one tide. A rented-ping ring fails: a rented recorder cannot reproduce another mouth's reflector delay. An honest agent pays 32 once and recovers the bond after audit.
